title: REBUILT kickoff evidence
role: The own-zone scorer stages allocated FUEL, drives loaded to a legal alliance-zone pose and feeds the active HUB.
revision: R2C-T1 low-rung lift and own-zone scorer

sources.label: R2C powered field counter and clock
sources.revision: Three field integration steps, one continuous FUEL identity

sources.label: R2C-T1 parked and hung contact study
sources.revision: 100 mm working stroke, 62 and 68 kg gross cases

results.conditions: 24 items onboard at second five, five seconds to travel, three to settle and 0.5 seconds per delivery.
results.limit: A schedule calculation. Acquisition, retained inventory and target crossings remain to be demonstrated.

results.claim: Congestion delayed two robots by 13.05 seconds apiece
results.conditions: Six occupied robot volumes in the kickoff AUTO rehearsal.
results.limit: A simulated AUTO conflict. Shift waits depend on other robots and the chosen route.

results.claim: Two of nine conditions cleared the HUB opening
results.conditions: One 215 g FUEL from carpet pickup and guided lift to the registered opening.
results.limit: Seven conditions stayed below the opening. The downstream trace reaches the bottom plate. Optical scoring and repeated service remain open.

results.claim: One active-HUB point at 16.987 s in Shift 1
results.conditions: One 215 g FUEL; +250 mm clear scoring approach; 1 m/s prescribed field roller and wheels; 30,000 N/m candidate contact input.
results.limit: The same passage earns zero in an inactive HUB. A stationary field counter retains the ball. Repeated service remains open.

results.claim: Two hooks supported the 62 kg robot with 51 mm tire clearance
results.conditions: The registered dock and passive screw lock held the robot for two seconds after power cutoff.
results.limit: The isolated contact study gives conditional Level 1 eligibility. Bearing strength, full route, fabrication and inspection remain open.

build.configuration: 26 × 26 × 20 in with 3 in trial bumpers. This earlier clearance experiment compared passing and blocked trench configurations.
Four-module swerve, hinged intake, two guided shelves, hopper and paired scoring wheels.
Two rear crown hooks deploy 215 mm. The carriage runs 100 mm of the native 115 mm slider limit.
